name: Fish crates
description: Two shallow slatted crates of fresh silver fish, one heaped with small fish and one with larger fish laid head to tail, beside a lidded wicker creel on a leather strap with a tail poking out, and one fish dropped on the ground.

provenance.prompt: Two crates of silver fish and a wicker creel, about 1.2 × 0.8 × 0.5 m.
